description: Dismiss a production-error signal as noise — it won't be resurfaced by later occurrences. A signal already filed as an incident cannot be dismissed (returns already_filed). Requires `write` scope.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Send the same key when retrying this exact call after a lost answer ("fetch failed"): the first call's result comes back and nothing is written twice. Reusing a key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_key_reused. 8-120 letters, digits, "_" or "-".

reason.description: Optional reason recorded on the dismissal.

name: anyforge_dismiss_observability_signal
title: Dismiss observability signal
